# Third chapter

The marker below names the second declared index, so this chapter places that
index and not the one the first chapter's marker placed. It is also the last
chapter of the book that places anything — which under M063's superseded rule
was where an index no marker names went, and under M063's rule is not.

A term for the index this chapter places: [Coriander]{.index index="beta"}.
